newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, arbitrage dominates.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, arbitrage dominates.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange leaped to 2,100 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 667 kilos as banks engaged heavily in arbitrage, dealers said.

Gold prices were mixed with dollar prices easing to $339 an ounce from $339.60 on Wednesday following trends in European markets. But Turkish lira prices firmed to 1,601,000 per gram from 1,600,000 as the lira weakened against the dollar.
The Turkish currency slipped to 147,000 to the dollar compared to 146,700 at Wednesday's close.
"Almost all of the day's deals were due to arbitrage, although there was some buying at one point by traders taking up positions on rising gold prices," one dealer said.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,890 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 60.7 percent of the total trade conducte in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
